entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems this is an explanation of the[n]rules for the dice game.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "Please enjoy this simple game in which[n]you guess the total number that will[n]appear on three cast dice."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "A correct prediction will double your[n]bet, while three matching dice will[n]triple it."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "Special cases aside, buy-in for this game[n]is only 25 coins."

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Either way, even if we won every time,[n]we'd have to play 1,960 separate rounds[n]of this game.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Having said that, this is a means of[n]winning coins. It should help us adjust[n]to gambling as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suggest we check it out, Joker.
